target_platform: Cloud-native containers (.NET 8 ASP.NET Core, Azure App Service / Kubernetes)

tech_stack.deployment: Docker container on Azure App Service / Kubernetes
tech_stack.observability: OpenTelemetry + Azure Application Insights, ILogger structured logging

services.name: catalog-service
services.responsibility: Owns the catalog product domain: browse/paginate, view, create, edit, and delete catalog items with validation and application-assigned id allocation. Server-rendered MVC admin UI plus the catalog data model.

schemas.name: CatalogDb
schemas.migration: bulk-ETL — repoint EF Core at the existing CatalogDb or bulk-load rows; preserve current sequence values for id continuity

communication.sync_protocol: HTTP (in-process MVC; no cross-service calls for this feature)

cross_cutting.auth: Deferred — admin UI; introduce ASP.NET Core authentication/authorization (e.g., Entra ID) as a platform concern
cross_cutting.observability: OpenTelemetry traces/metrics + Application Insights; ILogger structured logs replacing log4net
cross_cutting.error_handling: Global exception-handling middleware + ProblemDetails; FluentValidation for input; explicit 400/404 results
cross_cutting.secrets: Connection string and config via appsettings + environment variables + Azure Key Vault
